    Functors out of thin categories and a local cleaving criterion #

    A functor ThinCat T ⥤ Q is given by objects and a morphism for each pair le x y, compatible with composition (RayCat.ThinFunctorData). If Q has cancellation, such a functor is cleaving as soon as its morphisms are nonzero and Gabriel–Roiter's condition b) of 13.8 holds for a generating family of "arrows" of T (RayCat.ThinFunctorData.isCleaving).

    structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ThinFunctorData {V : Type} (T : ThinData V) (Q : Type) [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] :
    Type

    The data of a functor ThinCat T ⥤ Q.

    • obj : V → Q
    • mor (x y : V) : T.le x y → (self.obj x ⟶ self.obj y)
    • mor_id (x : V) : self.mor x x ⋯ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (self.obj x)
    • mor_comp (x y z : V) (h : T.le x y) (h' : T.le y z) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.mor x y h) (self.mor y z h') = if hn : T.nz x y z then self.mor x z ⋯ else 0

      structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ThinArrows {V : Type} (T : ThinData V) :
      Type

      A generating family of arrows of T: every strict relation starts with an arrow and ends with an arrow, with nonzero composites.

      • ar : V → V → Prop
      • ar_le (x y : V) : self.ar x y → T.le x y
      • ar_ne (x y : V) : self.ar x y → x ≠ y
      • first (x y : V) : T.le x y → x ≠ y → ∃ (z : V), self.ar x z ∧ T.le z y ∧ T.nz x z y
      • last (x y : V) : T.le x y → x ≠ y → ∃ (z : V), T.le x z ∧ self.ar z y ∧ T.nz x z y
